name: Summit AZ - GBP Post Proposals 2026-08-17
body:
> Plan · Summit Az · 2026-08-17

# Summary
Advance drafts of five Google Business Profile "Add update" posts for the week of Aug 17 to 21, 2026 (one per weekday), each with a real job photo from the Aug 14, 2026 photo set and a paste-ready caption with a Call now or Learn more button.

# Posts
1. Mon: water heater replacement (new electric tank, flex connectors, relief line).
2. Tue: garbage disposal replacement for a Mesa homeowner.
3. Wed: kitchen faucet installation.
4. Thu: leak and drain line diagnosis (a hole worn through a drain line, marked in the photo).
5. Fri: whole-home repipe with a labeled PEX manifold.

# Caution
- These drafts predate the later caption rules and business rules. They include an equipment brand name, "Arizona's trusted plumbing company", "for years to come", emojis, and a repiping consultation (repiping is off the promoted list). Captions should now have no brand names, no em dashes, no phone in the body, no emojis and only approved services.
- GBP is hands off for TAG except Kim's daily photo post (a standing EOD line); see [Summit AZ - GBP Optimization Proposal 2026-10-09](lib:brain-summit-az-gbp-optimization-proposal-2026-10-09).
